title: Launch checklist — redesign (improvements plan v2)

production_blockers.detail: Proofread VTT against the finished spoken recording once the MP4 exists
Set n8n_connection_outreachpage and N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET in production; sheet + SPF/DKIM/DMARC. Form path is the Calendly kill-switch fallback.
Set NEXT_PUBLIC_CALENDLY_EVENT_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_CALENDLY_ENABLED=1 on Vercel Preview and Production. Confirm invitee questions (name, work email, firm website) in Calendly.
On Preview, complete a test booking and confirm CSP does not block Calendly or Recaptcha (curl -I Content-Security-Policy).
Privacy notice and siteConfig.privacy.processors include Scheduling (Calendly).

not_blockers_for_redesign: Company number / registered address — redesign footer is copyright-only by design
